equipment.name: Rotary Screw Air Compressor
equipment.description: Multi-stage oil-flooded rotary screw air compressor with integrated air-cooling package and PLC control system.

components.name: Intake Air Filter
components.description: Heavy-duty particulate air filter protecting screw airend from airborne abrasive contaminants.
components.safetyNotes: Do not operate compressor with air filter element removed.

components.name: Air/Oil Separator Vessel
components.description: Cyclonic coalesce separator tank retaining oil droplets from compressed delivery air.
components.inspectionTips: Check minimum pressure valve and scavenging line orifice.
components.safetyNotes: Ensure vessel is fully vented to 0 PSI before loosening drain valve.

components.name: High-Efficiency Drive Motor
components.description: 75kW high-torque motor driving twin rotary rotors via multi-V belt drive.
components.inspectionTips: Check drive belt tension and motor bearing temperature.
components.safetyNotes: De-energize main electrical breaker switch prior to belt inspection.

additionalEquipment.name: Industrial Water Chiller
additionalEquipment.description: Closed-loop industrial refrigeration chiller servicing production cooling lines.

procedures.name: Compressor Daily Pre-Start Inspection
procedures.description: Mandatory operator walk-around check before engaging automated factory air system.

steps.title: Air Filter Differential Inspection
steps.instruction: Check the mechanical dust indicator on the intake filter housing. Clean or replace pleated filter if vacuum drop exceeds 50 mbar.
steps.warning: Never use compressed air at high pressure to blow dust back into the intake plenum.

steps.title: Oil Separator & Lubricant Level Check
steps.instruction: Inspect sight glass on separator reservoir. Oil level must reside between minimum and maximum marks while stopped.
steps.warning: Hot pressurized lubricant hazard: do not open oil fill plug while system is pressurized.

steps.title: Motor & Belt Drive Tension Assessment
steps.instruction: Check multi-ribbed belt deflection (approx 8-10mm under thumb pressure). Inspect motor fan cowl for airflow blockage.
steps.warning: Pinch point hazard: keep hands clear of pulleys and belt sheaves.

procedures.name: Emergency Shutdown Procedure
procedures.description: Rapid shutdown sequence for abnormal vibration, temperature runaway, or catastrophic oil loss.

steps.title: Engage E-Stop Switch
steps.instruction: Depress the emergency stop palm button located on the front control pedestal immediately.
steps.warning: Notify area supervisor immediately following any emergency shutdown event.

checklistItems.description: Air intake filter clean and free of physical obstruction
Separator reservoir synthetic oil level within normal range
Drive belt tension and alignment verified within manufacturer tolerance
All protective belt guards and acoustic canopy panels securely latched
No visible pneumatic leaks, oil weeping, or pooled fluids around skid base
Verify emergency stop button operates freely and triggers controller interlock
